definition: the country in central Europe, capital Berlin
description: A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.
